message: よい子はやっちゃダメ
Exams are completely over. Wanting to soak in the sense of freedom, I take the long way home. The clear autumn sky feels soothing on the eyes.

name: Sally
message: 「One full loooop!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's cheating~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? That weirdly drawling voice is--」
Lowering my gaze, I saw it was Mihoshizaka Park.

name: Sally
message: 「Nuh-uh, I totally did a full loop. Gimme my candy prize.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sally-chan, you were flapping your wings~, that's against the rules~」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm... hmmm? I-I dunno what you're talking about!」
Sacchin and Sally-chan are bickering in front of the swings.

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know what's going on, but... Sally-chan, you're totally playing dumb, aren't you?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun, hellooo!」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, 'sup!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hello.」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, that settles it! Time to skedaddle~♪」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sally-chan, wait up~, I'll give you the candy, so just listen to me~」

name: Sally
message: 「Really!? I'm listening, I'm listening, I'm listening!」

name: Synn
message: 「What happened?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ummm~, Sally-chan and I promised to play at the park together~」
...I want to know what chain of events led to that, but let's set that matter aside for now.

name: Sacchin
message: 「And then~, we got to talking about whether you can actually do a full loop on a swing~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! Everyone tried doing that when they were kids, right!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, so we figured we might as well bet something and have a swing showdown between the two of us~」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoever spins all the way around gets tons of candy♪」

name: Synn
message: 「...And then Sally-chan floated with her wings and cheated, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「*Jolt*」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Match-fixing is fine~ But cheating is a no-go~」
No, isn't match-fixing kind of bad too...?

name: Paqy
message: 「If you get caught cheating, people end up shedding blood just to save their worthless pride.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's right, you know~」

name: Sally
message: 「Hyoeeeeeh!? R-Really? I won't do it anymore, I'm sooorry~~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Here you go, the candy I promised~」

name: Sally
message: 「Yaho! It's the value-pack size! I'll open the bag right now, have some too, Prez!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks.」

name: Sally
message: 「Wh-wh-whoa, the bag is stiff...!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Uuu~ Doing a full loop on a swing really is just an impossible dream, isn't it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Actually, Nanaka and I pulled it off when we were little?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nunah!? Dost thou claim to have accomplished such a grand feat in thine infancy~」

name: Synn
message: 「It's no big deal. You can do it if it's a box-style swing instead of a normal one. Takes a pretty long time to build up momentum, though.」

name: Sally
message: 「It won't opeeenn, grrrrrr...!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Pull off a godlike stunt like that, and you'd instantly become everyone's hero...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「C-Could that be why Nana-chan feels that way about you, Synn-kun!? You heart-stealer!!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, we're--」

name: Sally
message: 「Mrgh!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Wawah~!? It's raining candy~」

name: Sally
message: 「Ufufu, ufufufu~ Talk about a sweet shower, am I right?」

name: Sally
message: 「Later!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You didn't have to run away~ The wrappers are sturdy, so you can totally still eat them if we pick them up~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin, about the rest of that memory just now...」
I continue my story while picking up the candy scattered across the ground alongside Sacchin.

name: Synn
message: 「The moment we jumped off the swings overjoyed, Dad, Mom, and Nanaka's folks came running over.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, we got scolded real good. That was the first time I ever got smacked by someone else's parents.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Wait, did your mom smack Nana-chan too, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, though just lightly.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm so jealous of you, Synn-kun--you share so many memories with Nana-chan.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Still, autumn is the season for love, ya know? I'm gonna do my best too!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get it, but I'm rooting for you, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe--you really don't get it at all, do you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Sacchin and I picked up all the candies and split them evenly three ways, including Sally-chan's share.
